CONTEXT:
Work in {project_root} on {date}. V750 produced ten primaries and skipped four studies. Exp8749 passed archive and method controls but covered 324/325 owned statements; v750_archive_runner.py line 354 was missing. Keep that primary disqualified. Exp8760 has no new supervisor outcomes. V751 has exactly thirteen tasks, Exp8763 through Exp8775.

EXISTING CODE TO READ FIRST:
CLAUDE.md; CODEX.md; ops/e2e-test-plan.md; ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml; openspec/capabilities/research-reporting/spec.md; openspec/capabilities/verification/spec.md; scripts/experiment_template.py; python/carnot/reporting/primary_publication.py; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-vNEXT.md; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-v750-preserved-20261103.md; research-references.md; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-v749-preserved-20261102.md; python/carnot/reporting/roadmap_contract.py; python/carnot/reporting/v748_collection_contract.py; python/carnot/reporting/v749_contract_runner.py; tests/python/test_v748_contract_8723.py; tests/python/test_v749_contract_methods_8737.py; results/experiment_8737_v749_contract_methods.json; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-v748-preserved-20261102.md; openspec/change-proposals/v744-methods-protocol.json; python/carnot/reporting/v750_archive_bound.py; python/carnot/reporting/v750_archive_runner.py; tests/python/test_v750_archive_bound_8749.py; results/experiment_8749_v750_archive_bound_contract.json; python/carnot/reporting/arc_authoritative_frontier_8215.py; results/experiment_8760_v750_arc_horizon_sensitivity.json

TASK:
Bind thirteen tasks and close the measured archive-runner coverage gap. Deliver results/experiment_8763_v751_branch_contract.json. Use thin runner scripts/experiments/experiment_8763_v751_branch_contract.py, raw evidence results/raw/experiment_8763_v751_branch_contract/ and notes docs/research-notes/v751-branch-contract.md. No LLM is needed. A future model need changes the task scope and requires the mandated unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF; it does not authorize a substitute or simulated inference.

CONCRETE STEPS:
1. Print a flushed progress line at each phase boundary and before and after any model load, generation, benchmark or subprocess that can take minutes. Print inner-loop counts and a parent heartbeat at least every 60 seconds during long calls; keep every gap under 600 seconds. Poll long processes with tool calls of at most 60 seconds. Write any file over about 200 lines in several tool calls, with a progress message between them. Do not compose a huge file in one tool call. Silence can end the task at 1200 seconds despite the 4800-second hard cap. Reserve at least 900 seconds for validation and publication; stop new work early enough to publish the actual terminal outcome.
2. Read the listed sources and prior failure entries. Confirm REQ-REPORT-V751-PLAN and the task-specific REQ-* / SCENARIO-* before code changes; write failing tests first. Check writable private scratch, dependencies and frozen input hashes before launching. Freeze methods, test node IDs, source and configuration identities before measurement. Reuse existing modules and thin runners; do not copy a whole previous experiment. Use private fixture roots; never let a test write production results or operator-curated docs.
3. Bind the visible table, complete task JSON, YAML and independently pinned canonical SHA-256 for all thirteen tasks. Compare every field including prompts, routing, lineage and gates. Preserve the complete V750 archive byte-for-byte. Accept only the established literal-brace activation encoding; reject substantive prompt mutations.
4. Exercise the real private_control branch that Exp8749 coverage missed, including its failure publication and exit, under actual CLI coverage. Retain all original archive-root, historical-reader and owned-failure assertions. Reuse qualified V748/V749 archived fixture recipes; prove they survive V751 at the moving roadmap. Do not mark coverage by hand or exclude the missed line. Report the complete original union and new statements.
5. Authenticate the unchanged v744-methods-protocol.json and current learner sources. Emit learning_protocol_ready_score only for full method custody and owned qualification. Freeze the fixed scientific estimands, splits and thresholds; a contract result grants no learning benefit.
6. Read the qualified Exp8760 frontier and authoritative supervisor locator once. Authenticate only events beyond its frozen frontier and require actual selected/applied arm outcomes, not copied or synthetic events. Emit arc_new_outcomes_available_score=1 only for such new bytes and complete locator checks. Otherwise set it to 0 with the exact missing-input reason; this pre-gates Exp8773 before an agent call. No game, model or polling loop runs.
7. Run private E2E-018/021 plus full-object mutations and an owned-failure control that zeros branch readiness. Keep contract, learning custody and new ARC evidence findings separately named; an empty ARC ledger must not zero learning custody.
8. Run complete scoped unit and consumer checks, actual coverage of every newly owned executable statement including real CLI children, Ruff check/format, strict mypy, explicit spec coverage and the applicable named E2Es. Preserve original assertions and negative controls. Retain argv, exits, node outcomes, JUnit, coverage and log hashes. Record unrelated repository health separately; never claim a full-suite pass. Publish only terminal bytes after unchanged adversarial_verify.py, verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict and fresh-process cold replay. Reconcile OpenSpec, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md. Do not edit active research-roadmap.yaml, scripts/research_conductor.py, ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml, generator weights, shared validation rules or ARC policy defaults.

REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS:
experiment_id, task_id, milestone, run_date, invocation_id: principle: Bind evidence to one actual invocation.
honest_verdict, verdict_class: principle: Use complete_ as the terminal verdict prefix. The closed enum is positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only retryable unfinished owned work is partial; unchanged missing, retired or rejected external inputs are blocked.
gate_check_summary: principle: Every blocked_* or complete_blocked_* result names upstream, path/hash, failed check, field, operator, expected and observed value. Distinguish missing file, missing field, zero and rejected producer. Use this exact field name.
inference_substrate, inference_substrate_class, MODEL_SPECS, model_invocation_counts: principle: This task is no_model_load with MODEL_SPECS=[] and zero LLM calls. Select aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts or verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates only when accurate. Numerical training is recorded separately.
rows, intended_count, completed_count, failed_count, censored_count, excluded_count, independent_count: principle: Emit one auditable row per unit and arm, including raw metrics, missingness and denominators. Seeds, siblings, representations and repeats do not multiply independent scientific cases.
verifier_is_oracle, exposure_scope, independent_generalization_score: principle: Oracle-dependent gains are circular_positive; constructed or inspected evidence does not establish natural or hidden-game transfer.
acceptance_gates, required_checks_passed, flagged_adversarial, validation_receipts, terminal_validation_sidecar_path: principle: Owned validation failure suppresses readiness. Keep execution acceptance separate from scientific promotion, so a valid null may release complete rows.
preconditions_checked, started_at_utc, ended_at_utc, duration_s, phase_spans, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum: principle: Use real current-invocation clocks, bounded work and explicit resources; never pad duration floors or reuse old monotonic epochs.
source_artifact_hashes, code_config_hashes, raw_shard_hashes, cited_upstream_artifacts, field_principles: principle: Authenticate imported evidence and derived metrics against immutable source bytes.
repository_health_reference, scoped_validation_scope: principle: A separate bounded global health diagnostic neither proves a full-suite pass nor replaces owned validation.
contract_ready_score, learning_protocol_ready_score, arc_new_outcomes_available_score, full_task_objects, canonical_tasks_sha256, original_node_union, owned_statement_coverage, historical_fixture_rows, arc_frontier_reference, arc_new_outcome_refs: principle: Exact administrative custody and fresh evidence admission are separate branch predicates.
